_doc: Newsletter packs: finished, on-brand product newsletters the generator clones-and-rewrites (mirrors products/registry.json). templatePath = the coded email template in the HubSpot Design Manager; its source of truth is renderers/email/templates/product-newsletter.html (upload via `hs cms upload`). The template renders a logo masthead, a centered heroHeadline, an optional intro, and a stack of feature rows. Each feature has an `image` (an assetKey into assets/library.json, rendered from Figma + hosted in HubSpot File Manager at generate time — or a direct https URL), a `headline`, a `body`, and an optional `ctaLabel`/`ctaUrl`. Slots are filled by overriding content.widgets[name] (see renderers/email/HUBSPOT-INTEGRATION.md). System: renderers/email/design-system.md. Validated by tools/validate_newsletters.py.

kitchen-station.subject: Clean Water, On Demand
kitchen-station.previewText: Tap water can hide invisible contaminants like PFAS, chlorine, and microplastics — linked to health risks and off-flavors.
kitchen-station.intro: Meet the Kitchen Station — purified, remineralized Bluewater straight from your tap.

features.headline: Is Your Tap Water Safe?
features.body: Tap water can hide invisible contaminants like PFAS, chlorine, and microplastics — linked to health risks and off-flavors. The Kitchen Station removes them at the source.

features.headline: Purified and Remineralised Water
features.body: SuperiorOsmosis™ purifies water up to 99.7%, removing PFAS, chlorine, and microplastics. Then it adds back essential Swedish minerals — calcium and magnesium — for cleaner, balanced water that tastes great.

features.headline: Bluewater O
features.body: A user-friendly control for the Kitchen Station 1™, enabling easy switching between municipal and purified, mineralized water.

features.headline: Bluewater App
features.body: Allows you to precisely adjust your mineral intake, offering complete control over water's taste and health benefits.

specs.heading: SuperiorOsmosis™ purification.
specs.body: Removes contaminants down to the molecular level.

specs.heading: Liquid Rock® minerals.
specs.body: A 2:1 calcium-to-magnesium electrolyte blend from Sweden's ancient bedrock.

specs.heading: Four mineral intensities.
specs.body: Light, Original, Medium, and Bold — matched to your taste.

specs.heading: On demand, zero effort.
specs.body: Functional, mineralized water straight from the tap.
